Responses reconstructed from InstaBox's public OpenAPI document
(https://api.instabox.sh/v1/openapi.json, info.version 1.0.0, the
Machine, Operation, MachineList, ExecResult and Error schemas) and the API
pages under https://instabox.sh/docs/api/ (machines.md, operations.md,
commands.md), read 2026-11-11. No live call was made and no key was used;
field names and shapes are the spec's, values are illustrative (the machine
id follows the documented `m_` plus 26 lowercase base32 characters form).
